Machine Learning Platform Lead

Wide World Importers Hybrid in Lisbon, Portugal Full-time Apply easily in one click Posted 1 week ago

SYNTHETIC POSTING. Wide World Importers is hiring a Machine Learning Platform Lead to run the team that keeps every model in the company fed, versioned and reproducible. The platform you build here is used by two hundred engineers who do not want to think about it, which is the whole point: the best platform work is invisible until it is missing, and then it is the only thing anyone can talk about.

What you will do

  • Own the feature store, the training pipelines and the model registry.
  • Set the contract between a data scientist's notebook and a running service, and keep that contract short enough to remember.
  • Lead four platform engineers through planning, review and on-call.
  • Drive the migration from ad hoc batch jobs to a streamed pipeline without losing a single nightly training run.
  • Publish the internal standards for evaluation, promotion and rollback.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of software engineering, at least four of them on machine learning infrastructure.
  • Deep Python; working knowledge of Go or Scala is welcome but not required.
  • Production experience with Airflow, Kubeflow or an equivalent.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes at a scale where a bad rollout is noticed by customers before it is noticed by alerts.
  • A record of mentoring senior engineers, not only of shipping.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with online serving and low latency inference.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring and drift detection.
